---
title: "`r params$title`"
subtitle: "`r paste(Filter(nzchar, c(params$client, params$project, params$runID, params$assay)), collapse = ' | ')`"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%Y-%m-%d')` · Report ID `r params$reportID` · revision `r params$revision`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    toc_depth: 2
    self_contained: true
params:
  title: ""
  # ---- Report details ---------------------------------------------------
  reportID: ""          # unique ID, e.g. "covid19_biogune_COVr01_MS_AA_QC_20261109"
  revision: 0                 # 0 = original; 1, 2, ... for a reissued report
  supersedes: ""              # ID of the report this one replaces (if revision > 0)
  client: ""                  # Client contact name
  contact: ""                 # Client contact details (e.g., email)
  sampleReceivedDate: ""      # Date the samples were received (YYYY-MM-DD)
  project: ""
  runID: ""            # e.g. "COVr01"
  assay: ""                 # SCFA, AA, BA, TRY or ddhN
  methodID: ""              # method / SOP reference and version
  instrument: ""        # instrument name or serial number
  # ---- Data ---------------------------------------------------------------
  data: "" # exported files, a folder, or an .rds file -- see the note below
  fileType: ""             # "xml", "tsv" or "txt"; blank = from the file extensions
  plateOrder: ""              # e.g. "COVp02, COVp01"; blank = automatic
  scale: TRUE                 # TRUE = plot log10(value + 1)
  # ---- Sign-off (initials) ------------------------------------------------
  ms_specialist_1: ""       # data processed and report prepared
  ms_specialist_2: ""       # QC results independently reviewed
  ms_lead: ""               # report authorised for release
  # ---- Notes ----------------------------------------------------------------
  notes: ""                 # deviations / remarks; for several lines use  notes: |
  # ---- Working range and measurement uncertainty ------------------------------
  uncertainty: ""           # blank = the package table for the assay (inst/uncertainty/<assay>.csv),
                            # or the path to your own CSV for this report
  # ---- Set by generateReport() (in this notebook, use the edit-here chunk) ----
  materials: !r NULL
  decisions: !r NULL
---

<!--
MS QC REPORT NOTEBOOK (ISO/IEC 17025): one copy per run.

Two ways to use it:
  - call ms.qc.report::generateReport(), which fills in the YAML values from
    its arguments, or
  - copy this file, fill it in and knit it. Knitted from inside the
    ms.qc.report source folder it uses devtools::load_all(); anywhere else it
    uses the installed package.

1. Copy this file for the run, e.g. covid19_biogune_PLA_COVr01_MS_AA_QC.Rmd.
2. Point `data:` in the YAML header at the run's data. Any of:
     - a folder of exports:   data: "~/Downloads/BA_xml/"
     - a series of files, comma-separated, all the same type:
         data: "~/exports/COVp01.xml, ~/exports/COVp02.xml"
     - a wildcard:            data: "~/exports/COVp*.xml"
     - a saved dataElement:   data: "~/run/covid19_biogune_PLA_COVr01_MS_AA.rds"
   Use / in paths, not \.
3. Fill in the YAML header above (or Knit > Knit with Parameters...).
4. Fill in the "edit-here" chunk below: laboratory, reference material lots,
   CAUTION decisions.
5. Write any deviations or remarks in `notes:` in the YAML header.
   The working range / uncertainty table comes from inst/uncertainty/<assay>.csv
   in the package (edit it in Excel), or from your own CSV via `uncertainty:`.
6. Knit. The report shows DRAFT until it has a report ID, all three sign-off
   initials and a decision for every CAUTION result; then AUTHORISED.
-->

```{r edit-here, include=FALSE}
# ============================================================================
# EDIT HERE: laboratory, reference materials and CAUTION decisions.
# ============================================================================

lab <- list(
  name     = "Australian National Phenome Centre (ANPC)",
  address  = "5 Robin Warren Dr, Murdoch WA 6150",
  location = "Analysis performed at the ANPC laboratory"
)

# Lots / IDs of calibrants, QC material and internal standards used in this run
materials <- data.frame(
  Material   = c("Calibrants", "QC material", "Internal standard mix"),
  `Lot / ID` = c("", "", ""),
  check.names = FALSE
)

# One row per CAUTION result once reviewed (see the CAUTION review section,
# which lists every CAUTION result and the criteria it failed).
#   disposition:   "Accept", "Re-run" or "Reject"
#   justification: required for "Accept"
decisions <- data.frame(
  plate         = character(0),
  analyte       = character(0),
  disposition   = character(0),
  justification = character(0)
)
# Example:
# decisions <- data.frame(
#   plate         = c("SRVp001", "SRVp002"),
#   analyte       = c("GCA", "TLCA"),
#   disposition   = c("Accept", "Re-run"),
#   justification = c("Low calibrant excluded per SOP; R2 0.996 after exclusion", NA)
# )

# Values passed by generateReport() take the place of the tables above
if (!is.null(params$materials)) materials <- params$materials
if (!is.null(params$decisions)) decisions <- params$decisions
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(htmltools)
library(fusion)
# generateReport() has already loaded ms.qc.report. Knitted by hand from the
# source folder, load it from source; anywhere else, use the installed package.
if (!isNamespaceLoaded("ms.qc.report")) {
  in_source <- !is.null(tryCatch(pkgload::pkg_path("."), error = function(e) NULL))
  if (in_source) devtools::load_all(quiet = TRUE) else library(ms.qc.report)
}
library(ms.qc.report)

# empty / NULL-safe text from a parameter
txt <- function(x) if (is.null(x) || !length(x) || all(is.na(x))) "" else paste(x, collapse = ", ")

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
options(knitr.kable.NA = "")

# ---- Load the data ------------------------------------------------------------
input_files <- character(0)

if (is(params$data)[1] == "character") {

  paths <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(params$data, ",", fixed = TRUE)))
  paths <- path.expand(paths[nzchar(paths)])

  if (length(paths) == 1 && grepl("\\.rds$", paths, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    # a saved dataElement
    dae <- readRDS(paths)
    input_files <- paths

  } else {
    # exported files: a folder, a series of files, or a wildcard
    pattern <- if (nzchar(txt(params$fileType))) paste0("\\.", params$fileType, "$") else "\\.(xml|tsv|txt)$"
    input_files <- unique(unlist(lapply(paths, function(p) {
      if (dir.exists(p)) {
        sort(list.files(p, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE))
      } else if (grepl("[*?]", p)) {
        sort(Sys.glob(p))
      } else {
        p
      }
    })))

    if (length(input_files) == 0) {
      stop("No matching files found in: ", paste(paths, collapse = ", "))
    }
    not_found <- input_files[!file.exists(input_files)]
    if (length(not_found)) stop("File(s) not found: ", paste(not_found, collapse = ", "))

    file_type <- unique(tolower(tools::file_ext(input_files)))
    if (length(file_type) > 1) {
      stop("All files must be the same type; found: ", paste(file_type, collapse = ", "))
    }

    # Read every file with the ms.parser reader for the assay (e.g. readBA),
    # stack the rows, then build one dataElement -- what parseMS() does for a
    # folder. Unlike rbind() on separate dataElements, this also works when
    # plates don't all have the same analytes.
    reader <- getExportedValue("ms.parser", paste0("read", params$assay))
    long <- do.call(rbind, lapply(input_files, function(f) reader(file = f, optns = list())))
    dae <- parseMS(folder = long, assay = params$assay)
  }

} else {

  dae <- params$data

}

plate_order <- if (nzchar(txt(params$plateOrder))) trimws(strsplit(txt(params$plateOrder), ",")[[1]]) else NULL
assay <- dae@method
```

```{r qc-and-status, include=FALSE}
# ---- QC results (from ms.qc.report) ------------------------------------------
table_data <- summaryTables(dae = dae, plateOrder = plate_order)
plate_data <- table_data$data[setdiff(names(table_data$data), "allPlates")]
plates     <- names(plate_data)
analytes   <- unique(unlist(lapply(plate_data, `[[`, "AnalyteName")))

# Acceptance criteria: taken from the package when it defines them
crit <- tryCatch(get("QC_CRITERIA", envir = asNamespace("ms.qc.report")),
                 error = function(e) list(R2_MIN = 0.99, ACC_RANGE = c(80, 120),
                                          QC_PASS_MIN = 66, RSD_MAX = 20))
ref_type  <- if (identical(assay, "SCFA")) "pqc" else "ltr"
rsd_label <- if (ref_type == "pqc") "PQC RSD" else "LTR RSD"

# ---- CAUTION review: failed criteria + decisions --------------------------------
failed_criteria <- function(r) {
  out <- character(0)
  r2 <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(r$R2))
  qcp <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(r$totalQCPassPerc))
  rsd <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(r$LTR_RSD))
  if (is.na(r2)) out <- c(out, "R2 not reported")
  else if (r2 < crit$R2_MIN) out <- c(out, sprintf("R2 %.4f < %s", r2, crit$R2_MIN))
  if (is.na(qcp)) out <- c(out, "no QC injections")
  else if (qcp < crit$QC_PASS_MIN)
    out <- c(out, sprintf("QC pass %s%% (%s) < %s%%", qcp, r$totalQCInjectionPass, crit$QC_PASS_MIN))
  if (is.na(rsd)) out <- c(out, paste(rsd_label, "not calculable (< 2 values)"))
  else if (rsd > crit$RSD_MAX) out <- c(out, sprintf("%s %.2f%% > %s%%", rsd_label, rsd, crit$RSD_MAX))
  paste(out, collapse = "; ")
}

review <- do.call(rbind, lapply(plates, function(p) {
  d <- plate_data[[p]]
  d <- d[is.na(d$PassFail) | d$PassFail == "CAUTION", , drop = FALSE]
  if (!nrow(d)) return(NULL)
  data.frame(Plate = p, Analyte = d$AnalyteName,
             `Failed criteria` = vapply(seq_len(nrow(d)), function(k) failed_criteria(d[k, ]), ""),
             check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
if (is.null(review)) {
  review <- data.frame(Plate = character(0), Analyte = character(0),
                       `Failed criteria` = character(0), check.names = FALSE)
}

# Check the decisions and merge them in
dec <- decisions
names(dec) <- tolower(names(dec))
dec_map <- c(accept = "Accept", accepted = "Accept", rerun = "Re-run",
             reject = "Reject", rejected = "Reject")
dec$disposition <- unname(dec_map[tolower(gsub("[^A-Za-z]", "", dec$disposition))])
if (any(is.na(dec$disposition))) {
  stop("In `decisions`, disposition must be \"Accept\", \"Re-run\" or \"Reject\".")
}
no_just <- dec$disposition == "Accept" &
  (is.na(dec$justification) | !nzchar(trimws(dec$justification)))
if (any(no_just)) {
  stop("In `decisions`, a justification is required to accept: ",
       paste(dec$plate[no_just], dec$analyte[no_just], collapse = ", "))
}
m <- match(paste(review$Plate, review$Analyte), paste(dec$plate, dec$analyte))
review$Disposition   <- dec$disposition[m]
review$Justification <- dec$justification[m]
unmatched <- !paste(dec$plate, dec$analyte) %in% paste(review$Plate, review$Analyte)

# ---- Working range and measurement uncertainty ---------------------------------
# Default: the package table for the assay. A CSV path in `uncertainty:` (or a
# data frame from generateReport()) replaces it for this report.
unc_source <- params$uncertainty
if (is.data.frame(unc_source)) {
  unc <- unc_source
  unc_from <- "table supplied for this report"
} else {
  unc_file <- if (nzchar(txt(unc_source))) path.expand(txt(unc_source)) else
    system.file("uncertainty", paste0(assay, ".csv"), package = "ms.qc.report")
  if (nzchar(unc_file) && !file.exists(unc_file)) stop("Uncertainty file not found: ", unc_file)
  unc <- if (nzchar(unc_file)) utils::read.csv(unc_file, check.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8",
                                               stringsAsFactors = FALSE) else NULL
  unc_from <- if (nzchar(txt(unc_source))) basename(unc_file) else
    if (nzchar(unc_file)) paste0("package table inst/uncertainty/", assay, ".csv") else ""
}
if (!is.null(unc)) {
  unc$analyte <- trimws(unc$analyte)
  unc_missing <- setdiff(analytes, unc$analyte)               # in the run, not in the table
  unc <- unc[unc$analyte %in% analytes, , drop = FALSE]        # only analytes in this run
  unc <- unc[order(match(unc$analyte, analytes)), , drop = FALSE]
} else {
  unc_missing <- analytes
}
unc_no_U <- is.null(unc) || !"U_percent" %in% names(unc) || all(is.na(unc$U_percent) | unc$U_percent == "")

# ---- Sign-off ----------------------------------------------------------------------
signoff <- data.frame(
  Role = c("MS specialist 1", "MS specialist 2", "MS Lead"),
  Responsibility = c("Data processed and report prepared",
                     "QC results independently reviewed",
                     "Report authorised for release"),
  Initials = toupper(trimws(c(txt(params$ms_specialist_1), txt(params$ms_specialist_2), txt(params$ms_lead)))),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
signed <- nzchar(signoff$Initials)
repeated <- unique(signoff$Initials[signed][duplicated(signoff$Initials[signed])])

# ---- Software provenance (ISO 17025 7.11) --------------------------------------------
pkg_dir <- dirname(system.file("DESCRIPTION", package = "ms.qc.report"))
git <- function(...) tryCatch(
  suppressWarnings(system2("git", c("-C", shQuote(pkg_dir), ...), stdout = TRUE, stderr = FALSE)),
  error = function(e) character(0))
pkg_commit <- git("rev-parse", "--short", "HEAD")
pkg_commit <- if (length(pkg_commit) == 1 && nzchar(pkg_commit)) pkg_commit else NA_character_
pkg_dirty  <- !is.na(pkg_commit) && length(git("status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=no")) > 0

# ---- Report status ----------------------------------------------------------------
reasons <- c(
  if (!nzchar(txt(params$reportID))) "No report ID",
  if (params$revision > 0 && !nzchar(txt(params$supersedes))) "Revised report: `supersedes` is empty",
  if (any(!signed)) paste("Sign-off missing:", paste(signoff$Role[!signed], collapse = ", ")),
  if (any(is.na(review$Disposition)))
    sprintf("%d CAUTION result(s) without a decision", sum(is.na(review$Disposition)))
)
status <- if (length(reasons)) "DRAFT" else "AUTHORISED"
notes_banner <- c(
  if (length(repeated)) sprintf("The same initials (%s) appear in more than one sign-off role.",
                                paste(repeated, collapse = ", ")),
  if (pkg_dirty) sprintf("ms.qc.report was run from source with uncommitted changes (commit %s).",
                         pkg_commit),
  if (any(unmatched)) paste("Decision(s) that match no CAUTION result were ignored:",
                            paste(dec$plate[unmatched], dec$analyte[unmatched], collapse = ", ")),
  if (length(unc_missing)) sprintf("%d analyte(s) have no working range / uncertainty entry (see that section).",
                                   length(unc_missing))
)
generated <- Sys.time()
```

```{r status, results='asis'}
if (length(reasons)) cat("<ul>", paste0("<li>", reasons, "</li>", collapse = ""), "</ul>")
if (params$revision > 0 && nzchar(txt(params$supersedes))) {
  cat(sprintf("<p>This report supersedes report <strong>%s</strong>.</p>", params$supersedes))
}
for (n in notes_banner) cat(sprintf("<p>Note: %s</p>", n))
```

## QC criteria and decision rule

An analyte is **PASS** on a plate only if all three criteria are met:

| Metric | Criterion | Sample type |
|---|---|---|
| `R2` | ≥ `r crit$R2_MIN` | calibration |
| `totalQCPassPerc` | ≥ `r crit$QC_PASS_MIN`% of QC injections with Accuracy/Recovery between `r crit$ACC_RANGE[1]`% and `r crit$ACC_RANGE[2]`% | `qc` |
| `r if (ref_type == "pqc") "PQC_RSD" else "LTR_RSD"` | ≤ `r crit$RSD_MAX`% | `r ref_type` |

**Decision rule.** Simple acceptance: each metric is compared directly against its limit; measurement uncertainty is not applied as a guard band, and a value equal to a limit meets it. If a metric cannot be calculated (no R2, no QC injections, or fewer than two `r ref_type` values), the analyte is **CAUTION**.

**CAUTION is not a release decision.** Every CAUTION result is reviewed and given a disposition (Accept with justification, Re-run, or Reject) in the [CAUTION review](#caution-review) before the report is authorised.

## Working range and measurement uncertainty

```{r uncertainty, results='asis'}
if (is.null(unc)) {
  cat("No working range / uncertainty table is available for assay", assay, "\n")
} else {
  shown <- unc
  names(shown)[names(shown) == "analyte"]   <- "Analyte"
  names(shown)[names(shown) == "units"]     <- "Units"
  names(shown)[names(shown) == "U_percent"] <- "Expanded uncertainty U (%, k = 2)"
  cat("Source:", unc_from, "\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(shown, row.names = FALSE))
  if (unc_no_U) {
    cat("\nExpanded uncertainty has not been entered in this table.\n")
  }
}
if (length(unc_missing)) {
  cat("\n**No entry for:**", paste(unc_missing, collapse = ", "),
      "(names must match the analyte names in the data exactly).\n")
}
```

## QC Summary Tables

```{r pressure1}
# Use tagList to collect and render HTML tables properly in a loop
html_output <- tagList()

for (table_name in names(table_data[["tables"]])) {
  table <- table_data[["tables"]][[table_name]]

  # Add a title for each table
  html_output <- tagAppendChild(html_output, h3(paste("Table for", table_name)))

  # Append table to html_output
  if (inherits(table, "gt_tbl")) {
    html_output <- tagAppendChild(html_output, table)  # Append gt table
  } else {
    html_output <- tagAppendChild(html_output, knitr::kable(table, caption = paste("Table for", table_name), format = "html"))
  }
}

# Render all tables at once
html_output
```

## CAUTION review {#caution-review}

```{r review, results='asis'}

  cat("No CAUTION results. All analytes met all criteria on every plate.\n")
} else {
  cat("Failed criteria are worked out from the QC results. Decisions come from the",
      "`decisions` table at the top of this notebook; blank rows are still open.\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(review, row.names = FALSE))
}
```

## Software

```{r software}
pkg_row <- function(pkg) {
  d <- suppressWarnings(utils::packageDescription(pkg))
  if (!is.list(d)) return(data.frame(Package = pkg, Version = "not installed", Commit = ""))
  data.frame(Package = pkg, Version = d$Version,
             Commit = if (!is.null(d$RemoteSha)) substr(d$RemoteSha, 1, 7) else "")
}
sw <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("ms.qc.report", "fusion", "ms.parser"), pkg_row))
if (!is.na(pkg_commit)) {
  sw$Commit[sw$Package == "ms.qc.report"] <- paste0(pkg_commit, if (pkg_dirty) " (uncommitted changes)" else "")
}
sw <- rbind(sw, data.frame(Package = "R", Version = paste(R.version$major, R.version$minor, sep = "."),
                           Commit = ""))
knitr::kable(sw, row.names = FALSE,
             caption = if (!is.na(pkg_commit)) "ms.qc.report was loaded from source; its commit is read from the source folder." else
               "Commit is shown for packages installed from GitHub.")
```
